answer: Trading capacity expires every epoch. echo derives an operator tag from a civil-registry nullifier, so key rotation cannot reset its identity count. ocean leases capacity only as one lot covering every active identity on that tag, and spiral charges the square of that count in USDC per epoch; lots cannot be divided or staggered. An honest debut pays 1 USDC. Adding the tenth clone raises the lot from 81 to 100 USDC, and ten heads cost 100 USDC every epoch.
